definitions.ask: Should short record fields (three words or fewer) share one line, instead of each taking its own line?
definitions.why: Packing meets the page limit with room to spare and keeps a 6 pt gap between records

choices.label: Short fields share a line, 6 pt record gap; most page margin (sase_core 17 of 19 pages)
Every field keeps its own line; record gap shrinks to 4 pt (sase_core 18 of 19 pages)
